'''Rizzler''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Ringtail]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Zorrock]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Rizzler figured wearing a mask keeps you safe from being recognized, but that charming smirk and familiar figure already left their mark on the hearts of many."

Rizzler is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A brown raccoon that wears a blue eye mask and cape. It stands bipedal and has off-white and orange accents in its fur. The end of its large, striped tail has blue fur. Rizzler maintains a mischievous facial expression.

Ringtail's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes instances of blue to green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Rizzler's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Zorrock]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Rizzler to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (Dig up treasure x40) or [[Cozy Farm]] (Use Fertilizer x2400).

== Trivia ==
* Rizzler and its evolutions were added to the game on 9/8/2026 alongside [[Blechlama]] and [[Morphanessa]].
